text: A 50 mL round-bottom flask with a magnetic stir bar was placed in an oil bath on top of a magnetic stir plate. To the round-bottom flask, 5 g of parent ester (FAEEc, FAMEc, or FAPEc) was added, heated to 60 °C, and agitated at 300 rpm.

source.title: Brown grease-derived ester base oils: tunable viscosity and cold-flow behaviour

unannotatable: other: oil bath on magnetic stir plate
